params.caption: Update channel name
params.description: Automatically update channel names using information provided by the enabled EPG providers. Note, this may cause unwanted changes to already defined channel names.

params.caption: Update channel number
params.description: Automatically update channel numbers using information provided by the enabled EPG providers. Note, this may cause unwanted changes to already defined channel numbers.

params.caption: Update channel icon
params.description: Automatically update channel icons using information provided by the enabled EPG providers. Note, this may cause unwanted changes to already defined channel icons.

params.caption: Periodically save EPG to disk (hours)
params.description: Writes the current in-memory EPG database to disk every x hours, so it can be re-read on the next startup (e.g. in case an unexpected shutdown occurs). Set to 0 to disable.

params.caption: Save EPG to disk after xmltv import
params.description: Writes the current in-memory EPG database to disk shortly after an xmltv import has completed, so should a crash/unexpected shutdown occur EPG data is saved (re-read on next startup).

params.caption: Process Parental Rating Labels
params.description: Convert broadcast ratings codes into human-readable labels like 'PG' or 'FSK 16'.

params.caption: Cron multi-line
params.description: Multiple lines of the cron time specification. The default cron triggers the internal grabbers daily at 12:04 and 00:04. See Help on how to define your own.

params.caption: Force initial EPG grab at start-up (internal grabbers)
params.description: Force an initial EPG grab at start-up (internal grabbers).

params.caption: Force initial EPG grab at start-up
params.description: Force an initial EPG grab at start-up.

params.caption: EIT processing (default)
params.description: Default EIT processing policy applied to services whose own "EIT processing" is set to Default. See Help for the full policy descriptions.

params.caption: Over-the-air Cron multi-line
params.description: Multiple lines of the cron time specification. The default cron triggers the over-the-air grabber daily at 02:04 and 14:04. See Help on how to define your own.

params.caption: EPG scan time-out in seconds (30-7200)
params.description: The maximum amount of time a grabber is allowed scan a mux for data (in seconds).

params.caption: Over-the-air Genre Translation
params.description:
Translate the genre codes received from the broadcaster to another genre code.
Use the form xxx=yyy, where xxx and yyy are 'ETSI EN 300 468' content descriptor values expressed in decimal (0-255).
Genre code xxx will be converted to genre code yyy.
Use a separate line for each genre code to be converted.
